objective: Reconstruct the supplied legal presentation cover as a fixed-size, non-responsive, offline-capable HTML artboard with independently addressable visual layers and a synchronized layer manifest.

tool_and_capability_discovery.image_generation: ChatGPT ImageGen, used to generate independent photographic assets and visual explorations.
tool_and_capability_discovery.image_processing: Local Python/Pillow processing used for image dimensions, alpha-aware asset preparation, embedding and file validation.
tool_and_capability_discovery.html_css: Standalone HTML and CSS implementation with inline SVG for vectors and circuitry.
tool_and_capability_discovery.font_handling: Locally available GFS Didot and Inter font files embedded into the HTML as data URIs.
tool_and_capability_discovery.browser_rendering: Chromium rendering, recorded by the layer manifest QA metadata.
tool_and_capability_discovery.capability_notes: No third-party asset library or remote font/image URL is required by the final HTML.

executed_workflow.name: Tool and plugin discovery
actions: Reviewed available image generation, file processing, coding and browser/rendering capabilities.
Selected image generation for photographic subjects, local processing for asset preparation, HTML/CSS for composition and inline SVG for vector details.
Avoided remote runtime assets to satisfy offline operation.
outputs: tool selection decisions recorded in this workflow

executed_workflow.name: Reference forensics and decomposition
actions: Inspected the supplied reference at its native 1536 by 864 pixel resolution.

Identified the deep oxblood editorial background, cream typography, gold accents, central courthouse architecture, brass justice scale, law books, stone platforms, right-side steps and AI circuit/network decoration.
Separated editable text and vector structures from photographic image subjects.
Used the supplied text content verbatim: LEGAL SYSTEMS IN TRANSITION; HOW AI AFFECTS CIVIL LAW; subtitle; presenter Aqsa; instructor Kazi Afzal Sir.

design_system.visual_style: cinematic editorial legal technology cover, warm sepia architecture, antique metallic subject, restrained circuit geometry

executed_workflow.name: Layer mapping and manifest specification
actions: Created 35 independently addressable layer records.
Assigned absolute X, Y, width and height coordinates relative to the 1536 by 864 artboard.
Recorded layer IDs, names, groups, production methods, z-index, opacity and other relevant styling metadata.
Documented asset provenance, embedded dimensions, file hashes and QA notes.

decisions.reason: Architectural photographic detail and atmospheric perspective are better represented by a dedicated generated image.
A realistic isolated still-life is required; independent transparent asset preserves the silhouette.
Complex metallic object, relief details and realistic lighting require a photographic asset.
Deterministic rectangles, gradients and clipping are more accurate and editable in CSS.

decisions.component: orbital arc, circuit paths and AI neural mesh
decisions.reason: Thin lines, nodes and geometry need crisp scalable vector rendering.
Text must remain selectable and editable HTML text.
Independent shapes and texture treatments are more controllable as vector/CSS layers than as another flattened image.

actions: Selected one courthouse image, one transparent law-books cutout and one transparent justice-scale cutout.
Reviewed generated images for crop suitability, background separation, visible artefacts and compositional fit.
Prepared transparent cutouts for use as independent layers.
Converted selected raster assets to embedded WebP data URIs for the standalone HTML.
Embedded required local font files as font data URIs.
executed_workflow.rejected_asset_policy: Full poster generations were kept out of the implementation because they flatten text and image content into one non-editable composition. Earlier subject variants were superseded by better isolated or more compositionally suitable assets.

executed_workflow.name: Artboard assembly
actions: Created a fixed 1536 by 864 pixel artboard.
Placed every visual layer using explicit coordinates and stacking order.
Layered the courthouse behind the foreground scale and books.
Built the AI traces and neural mesh as vector elements.
Constructed the stone platforms and six individual stair treads as independently addressable geometry.
Added restrained vignette and grain overlays to unify the composition.
executed_workflow.layer_implementation: Every manifest layer ID is represented as a corresponding data-layer attribute in the HTML.

executed_workflow.name: HTML and CSS implementation
actions: Built a single fixed-size artboard using semantic HTML containers and absolute positioning.
Used CSS for panels, fills, gradients, dividers, text placement and stacking.
Used inline SVG for orbital, circuitry, neural mesh and fine decorative paths.
Kept all meaningful text as HTML text.
Embedded all image and font resources directly into the HTML as data URIs.
Avoided external scripts, stylesheets, image requests and runtime dependencies.

executed_workflow.name: Visual quality assurance
reported_refinements: Adjusted the courthouse visual treatment to sit more naturally in the warm, subdued background.
Tightened the book and lower platform proportions.
Separated the right-side stone staircase into six individually documented tread layers.
executed_workflow.comparison_limitations: The visual review was performed on rendered screenshots. No numerical SSIM, MAE or pixel-difference score is claimed in the source manifest; the finished work is a high-fidelity reconstruction, not a pixel-identical extraction.

checks.evidence: 1536 x 864 input image and fixed artboard metadata.
35 manifest layer IDs and 35 unique HTML data-layer IDs; exact set equality: True.
3 embedded image data URIs and 4 embedded font data URIs.

known_limitations: Generated photographic assets are approximations of the pictured objects, not extracted pixels from the reference.
The output is visually reconstructed and editable, but is not guaranteed to be pixel-for-pixel identical to the supplied raster.
The recorded QA evidence documents three render review passes; no numerical pixel similarity score is asserted.
reproduction_instructions: Keep index.html and layer-manifest.json together for documentation and traceability; index.html itself is self-contained.
Open index.html in a modern browser. The artboard remains 1536 by 864 CSS pixels and does not responsively reflow.
Use layer-manifest.json as the source of truth for layer IDs, positions, groups, production methods and asset provenance.
